title: Peeto Sar Apne Ahle Azaa Wa-Wailaa
body:
PEETO SAR APNE AHLE AZAA WA-WAILAA
Maatam Karlo Bekas Ka Wa-wailaa
Aaj Naweeñ Hai Maah e Azaa Ki
Khatm Huwaa Shiyo Ashraa Wa-wailaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Kal Hai Qayamat Ka Samaañ Wa-wailaa
Honge Azaa Khaane Sunsañ Wa-wailaa
Kal Na Alam Hai Aur Na Yeh Mimbar
Aur Na Yeh Bazm e Aah O Bukaa Wa-wailaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Asr Ko Hogaa Kal Kohraam Wa-wailaa
Sajdeh Me Hoge Zibaah Imam Wa-wailaa
Haaye Katega Kund Churi Se Kal Shah e Deeñ Ka Pyaasa Galaa Wa-wailaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Honge Haram Kal Be-Pardaah Wa-wailaa
Lenge Laee'ñ Zainab Ki Ridaa Wa-wailaa
Baazuoñ Me Baandhenge Rasan Kal
Ukhdaa Kushaa Ki Beti Kaa Wa-wailaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Hogaa Yeh Ghar Kal Se Sunsaañ Wa-wailaa
Subah Ko Jaata Hai Mehmaañ Wa-wailaa
Ro'o Zari e Sheh Se Lipat Kar
Hote Hai Ruqsat Kal Maula Wa-wailaa
